subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose a current-session `resetSession(reason?)` capability to after-compaction plugin hooks, and should the separate live tool-failure behavior be removed from this PR?
rationale: This adds a public plugin mutation capability and changes default agent termination behavior, so code correctness alone cannot establish the intended permanent product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Narrow and split
options.body: Keep the current-session after-compaction API for focused review, remove the live failure guard from this PR, and require exact-head reset lifecycle proof.

options.title: Approve combined behavior
options.body: Intentionally ship both the hook API and always-on five-failure abort behavior with aligned configuration, documentation, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Decline the public hook API and retain session resets only in core-owned lifecycle code.

recommendation.title: Narrow and split
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session after-compaction API for focused review, remove the live failure guard from this PR, and require exact-head reset lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent compaction and loop-detection work is the closest available history signal for this product boundary.
